root_cause.text: The asynchronous crypto callback function `esp_output_done` fails to free the socket buffer (`skb`) when `esp_output_tail_tcp` returns an error (such as when the TX queue is full), resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `esp_output_done` (in both `net/ipv4/esp4.c` and `net/ipv6/esp6.c`), the return value of `esp_output_tail_tcp(x, skb)` was previously ignored. The patch fixes this by capturing the return value and calling `kfree_skb(skb)` if the return value is not `-EINPROGRESS`.
